description: This file implements a character escaper for JSON strings, handling escape sequences according to RFC 8259, including Unicode considerations for control characters, line break, and paragraph break characters.

classes.name: JsonCharEscaper
classes.description: A singleton class that implements character escaping for JSON strings, escaping control characters, quote, backslash, and Unicode line/paragraph separators.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of JsonCharEscaper.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Returns the escaped string for a given Unicode code point if escaping is necessary; otherwise null.
